from pathlib import Path
import difflib

protocol = Path("PROTOCOL.md").read_bytes().decode().splitlines(keepends=True)

diff = list(difflib.unified_diff(seed.splitlines(keepends=True), actual.splitlines(keepends=True), fromfile="PROTOCOL.md canonical", tofile="souji-shokunin/SHONEN.md"))
print(f"template_seed_lines={len(seed.splitlines())}")
print(f"target_lines={len(actual.splitlines())}")
print(f"byte_identical_modulo_name={seed == actual}")
print("diff=empty" if not diff else "".join(diff), end="\n" if not diff else "")
